system.description:
You raise your hand and generate an intensely dense torrent of wind that circles around you, creating a bubble of wind that envelops your entire body.

The barrier that envelops you has 2d12 + 6 hit points, resistance to Lightning damage and vulnerability to Fire damage.

If this jutsu would reduce damage from any of the listed damage types below, it will trigger an additional effect. Creatures in 15-foot radius centered on you must make a Dexterity saving throw to resist its effects.

Fire. All creatures make a saving throw becoming Burned on a failed save as the Fire spreads around you from your rotating bubble of wind.

Lightning. All creatures must make a saving throw becoming Shocked on a failed save, as lightning jumps from you to other creatures around you.

Cold. All creatures must make a saving throw becoming Chilled on a failed save, as the cold is spread to all creatures around you.

Earth. All creatures must make a saving throw, gaining the Bleed condition on a failed save, as they are pelted with shrapnel of earth.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the barriers hit points by +6.
